components.name: Print Filled Button
components.description: Orange fill with ink type for Add a cafe and primary print actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-print { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--kd-accent, #D9793B); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--kd-accent, #D9793B); color: var(--kd-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-print:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 22%, transparent); } .ds-btn-print:active { box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 22%, transparent); } .ds-btn-print:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Tag
components.description: Printed filter tag at rest — ink stroke on transparent shelf field.
components.css: .ds-chip-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 22%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--kd-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-filter:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 34%, transparent); } .ds-chip-filter:active { box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 35%, transparent); } .ds-chip-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Filter Tag Active
components.description: Active printed filter — orange fill, ink type.
components.css: .ds-chip-filter-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--kd-accent, #D9793B); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--kd-accent, #D9793B); color: var(--kd-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-filter-active:active { box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 22%, transparent); } .ds-chip-filter-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Search Underline
components.description: Full-width underline search on the cool shelf field.
components.html: <label class="ds-input-search"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.25" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search a coffee shop" /></label>
components.css: .ds-input-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 28%, transparent); color: var(--kd-ink, #1c1917); } .ds-input-search input { width: 100%; height: 46px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--kd-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 700; caret-color: var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); } .ds-input-search input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 50%, transparent); opacity: 1; } .ds-input-search:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); } .ds-input-search input:focus { outline: none; }

components.name: Bag Label
components.description: Cafe as a printed bag label — logo slot, name, Closed in brick, origin, then Hours / WiFi / Outlets as icon-plus-words; right save spine fills orange when saved.
components.css: .ds-bag { position: relative; margin: 0; padding: 16px 40px 12px 16px; background-color: #FAF8F5; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.34); border-radius: 16px; font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bag__open { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-bag__mast { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; } .ds-bag__logo { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: 0 0 auto; overflow: hidden; background-color: #FAF8F5; border: 1px solid rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.34); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-bag__copy { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .ds-bag__name { color: #1c1917; font-size: 1.325rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-bag__closed { color: #8c3a2f; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-bag__origin { color: #1c1917; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-bag__lines { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 12%, transparent); } .ds-bag__line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7rem max-content; column-gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; justify-content: start; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; font-size: 0.7875rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-bag__key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #1c1917; } .ds-bag__key svg { color: #D9793B; } .ds-bag__line > span:last-child { font-weight: 700; text-align: left; } .ds-bag__save { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: flex-end; width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 5px 0 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #D9793B; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bag.is-saved .ds-bag__save { color: #1c1917; } .ds-bag__save-fill { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 28px; background: #D9793B; clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transition: clip-path 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bag.is-saved .ds-bag__save-fill { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 18%, transparent); } .ds-bag__open:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-bag__open:active { opacity: 0.72; } .ds-bag__open:focus-visible, .ds-bag__save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1F6F6B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Destination

components.css: .ds-nav-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 48px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--kd-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-tab:active { transform: translateY(1px) scaleY(0.94); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #D9793B 22%, transparent); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Primary Menu
components.description: Bottom menu of Lucide icon plus word on flat shelf field #F2F2F2; an orange mark slides to the active tab; active label is teal.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); align-items: stretch; width: 100%; height: 72px; padding: 0 8px; background-color: #F2F2F2; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #1c1917 16%, transparent); } .ds-tabbar__mark { position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 8px; width: calc((100% - 16px) / 4); height: 2px; background: var(--kd-accent, #D9793B); border-radius: 1px; transform: translateX(calc(var(--tab-index, 0) * 100%)); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-nav-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--kd-ink, #1c1917); font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-tab-active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); font-family: 'Kumbh Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible, .ds-nav-tab-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--kd-primary, #1F6F6B); outline-offset: -4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tabbar__mark { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
KapeDoko reads like specialty coffee packaging laid on a cool off-white shelf: dark ink for reading, teal for brand chrome, and orange for actions and highlights. The product name stays kapé DOKO / KapeDoko. Home is a stack of bag labels — shop name with an optional logo slot, a small Closed line when closed, origin, then Hours / WiFi / Outlets as icon-plus-words — not photo cards, not a route plate, not a dashboard of chips and stars.

Density is quiet and vertical. Shelf, header, filters, and the bottom menu sit on flat cool field #F2F2F2. Each bag-label face (and partner cards) uses a flat warm white #FAF8F5 inside the hairline border — no stipple or shipping-tooth texture. Depth comes from that bordered flat face and ink rules, not lift shadows or textured panels. Map, Saved, and Profile keep their own layouts but inherit this palette and type.

Rejected by this system: warm enamel as the full-page field, Satoshi or condensed all-caps UI faces, floating elevated cards, icon-only bottom navigation without words, and a "Review WiFi and outlets" control on the bag label. Do not use orange as small body text on stock (≈2.8:1) — put ink on orange fills instead.
keyCharacteristics: Cool shelf field #F2F2F2; flat warm-white label faces #FAF8F5
Teal brand chrome, orange action accent, ink reading
Kumbh Sans only — variable Google Font, regular and bold, sentence case
Bag labels: 16px corners, logo slot left of name, Closed in brick under the name, facts as icon plus words
Menu is Lucide icon plus word; an orange mark slides to the active tab; active label is teal

rules.name: The Stock Reading Rule
rules.body: Body copy and cafe names stay ink #1c1917. Teal and orange are roles, not a whole-page tint.

rules.name: The Accent Contrast Rule
rules.body: Orange is for fills, marks, and amenity icons. Put ink on orange fills. Do not put orange text on cream stock.

rules.name: The Shelf Field Rule
rules.body: Shelf, header, filters hinterland, and the bottom menu sit on flat #F2F2F2. Bag-label faces use flat warm white #FAF8F5 — no bag-stock.png tile, no stipple. Do not paint texture across chrome.

rules.name: The Kumbh Sans-Only Rule
rules.body: UI type is Kumbh Sans regular or bold. Do not introduce Satoshi, condensed caps faces, serif display for body UI, or a second UI family.

rules.name: The Words-With-Icons Rule
rules.body: Hours, WiFi, outlets, and distance keep readable words; Lucide icons (~15px, orange) sit beside the keys. Closed stays a small brick text line under the name. The bottom menu pairs each Lucide icon with its word — never icon-only destinations.

rules.name: The Shelf Rule
rules.body: Home is one stacked column of labels under greeting + wordmark → search → optional partner placement → filters. Do not introduce photo grids, map-first chrome, or side-by-side cafe cards on this identity.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: No floating card shadows. Depth is border + flat label face only.

rules.name: The Label Corner Rule
rules.body: Interactive print pieces use 16px corners or a straight underline — not nearly-square corners or pill chips. Logo slots use 8px.

dos: Do keep shelf field #F2F2F2, ink #1c1917, teal #1F6F6B, and orange #D9793B as the identity on shared chrome and Home.
Do put ink on orange fills; use teal for focus, active tab labels, and brand chrome.
Do keep bag-label faces flat #FAF8F5 with no stipple; keep shelf and menu flat #F2F2F2.
Do set UI type in Kumbh Sans (400/700) and keep cafe facts as icon-plus-words.
Do treat each cafe as a bag label: logo slot, name, Closed when closed (brick), origin, then Hours / WiFi / Outlets.
Do pair each menu destination with a Lucide icon and word; mark the active tab with an orange indicator and teal label.
Do show partner placement only between search and filters when markerTier === 'partner'.
donts: Don't use orange as small text on cream stock (~2.8:1).
Don't recolor the whole page or cafe names to teal — body reading stays ink.
Don't use warm enamel #f6f1e8 as the page field or bag-label face — labels use flat #FAF8F5.
Don't revive Satoshi, condensed all-caps UI faces, white elevated cards, or the jeepney plate composition.
Don't ship icon-only menu destinations or replace amenity facts with icon-only rows.
Don't add a "Review WiFi and outlets" control on bag labels.
Don't fill the logo slot with the KapeDoko mark or invent logos.
Don't add drop shadows or pill chips to this identity.
Don't rename the product away from kapé DOKO / KapeDoko.
Don't bring back the bag-stock tooth/stipple on labels, shelf, header, or bottom menu.
Don't invent prices, ratings, or coverage claims as design system content.
